meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装上后它会按顺序带你走 6 步：验证集群、安装 AI Runway 控制器、评估 GPU、安装推理提供方、部署并验证首个模型、最后小结。每步会报告集群状态，安装或部署前先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你说 “setup AI Runway”、“airunway setup” 等，或想在已有 AKS 集群上跑模型时触发。它要求 AKS 集群已存在，否则先交给 azure-kubernetes 创建。

howto.what_en: Six ordered steps: verify the cluster, install the AI Runway controller, assess GPU, install an inference provider, deploy and verify a first model, then recap. Reports state each step and asks before installing anything.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "setup AI Runway", "airunway setup" and similar, or when deploying a model to an existing AKS cluster. Assumes a cluster exists; otherwise hands off to azure-kubernetes.
